articles.title: Thailand frees 18 Cambodian soldiers under new ceasefire deal
articles.summary: Cambodian soldiers, captured by Thailand in July, have been repatriated to Phnom Penh via military helicopter. Their release comes under the terms of a recent ceasefire agreement, signaling a significant de-escalation of border tensions between the two Southeast Asian nations. This marks a positive step towards regional stability.

articles.title: Russia releases video of Ukraine's attack on Prez Putin's residence
articles.summary: Russia's defence ministry released video footage in Moscow, presenting a downed drone as evidence. They claimed Ukraine attempted to attack a presidential residence this week using the drone. This briefing aimed to publicly demonstrate the alleged Ukrainian aggression, highlighting the ongoing conflict's reach and Russia's defensive actions against such perceived threats.

articles.title: Finnish authorities seize ship and crew after undersea cable cut, pursuing criminal charges — Finnish special forces board ship, detain all 14 crewmembers
articles.summary: An undersea telecommunications cable connecting Estonia and Finland was recently damaged for the fourth time in 1.5 years. Finnish special forces have secured the area, highlighting the potential for deliberate interference rather than mere accidents. This repeated damage to critical infrastructure between NATO allies raises significant regional security and communication vulnerability concerns, demanding robust defence readiness against hybrid threats.

articles.title: In evolving Latin America, US-Venezuela discord remains a constant
articles.summary: For 25 years, Venezuela's socialist government and oil wealth have defined its constant confrontation with the United States, a consistent feature in Latin America. This long-standing geopolitical dynamic, marked by ideological differences and resource control, continues to shape regional stability and international relations, with new tensions emerging this year, highlighting the enduring complexity.

articles.title: Taiwan stays on high alert as Chinese ships pull back after massive drills
articles.summary: Taiwan remains on high alert after China staged massive military drills around the island. Taiwan activated its emergency maritime response centre to monitor Chinese forces, underscoring escalating cross-strait tensions. This situation highlights the critical need for robust defence preparedness and strategic awareness in the Indo-Pacific, emphasizing potential regional instability and the importance of maritime security.

articles.title: Stunning Victories and Rising Repression: a look back at the global student movement for Palestine in 2025
articles.summary: Amidst the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, a global student uprising termed the 'Student Intifada' has emerged. Driven by concerns over alleged 'scholasticide and genocide' against Palestinians, this sustained movement advocates for Palestinian liberation, energizing and radicalizing students worldwide. It highlights growing international youth engagement on geopolitical and humanitarian issues.
